topic.title: Aerodrome Safeguarding / Public Safety Zones / Consultation

scope_guards: Proximity to an aerodrome is not proof of a safeguarding conflict.
A safeguarding consultation zone is not a development prohibition.
A consultation response is not planning permission.
No-objection advice is not evidence of completed construction.
A crane notice is not a permanent obstacle approval.
A public safety zone map is not exact-site risk quantification.
Completed development is not treated as safe without operational compliance evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact map, consultation, decision, construction and safety evidence.
